thread:
alex: SAST & DAST CI jobs are flapping. Root cause looks like two things: scanner SA can't decrypt a CI artifact (KMS) and the DAST is hitting internal-only health endpoints causing tons of low-value findings.

maria: I trimmed scanner SA perms last sprint. Didn't include kms:Decrypt for the specific key. We should add key-level decrypt but track via Terraform.

ravi: Quick hotfix: I'll run one-off gcloud to add kms:Decrypt on the single key for `ci-scanner@redwood-ci`. Will convert to TF within 48h.

lee: For noise, propose `security/scan-suppressions.yaml` that the scanners consult so internal paths are downgraded not blocked. Example entry: `path: ci-artifacts/internal/*`, reason, expire.

alex: Also add a CI pre-check: attempt to fetch an authenticated signed artifact before the scan runs and fail fast if 403 so we don't waste runs.

audit-bot: Found missing AdminActivity entries for earlier IAM changes. Recommend enabling alert on IAM policy delta for service accounts and weekly IAM-change summary to #eng-security.

maria: Agreed. Guardrails: one-off gcloud allowed for hotfix, but MUST be codified in TF and reviewed. No permanent suppressions without SEC ticket and security sign-off.

ravi: Hotfix applied. AdminActivity logged: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query;resource=project/redwood-ci;cursor=xyz. Opening TF PR now.

ale: Action items: ravi -> TF PR + hotfix link; lee -> suppression draft; maria -> enable IAM-change alert; alex -> CI auth-check and short runbook SEC-500.

alex: Thanks all, follow-up in SEC-500 postmortem.
